effect.tipsylib.berserk.description: Increases the user's attack damage the lower health out of max health they have.
effect.tipsylib.bleeding.description: Prevents the user to heal any health.
effect.tipsylib.brimstone_vision.descrip: Allows the user to see clearly under lava.
effect.tipsylib.chronos.description: Decreases the tick rate of the user's active effects.
effect.tipsylib.confusion.description: Disables advanced F3 and hides the user's health bar.
effect.tipsylib.creative_shock.descripti: Damages the user when attempting to build.
effect.tipsylib.lava_walking.description: Allows the user to walk on lava.
effect.tipsylib.perception.description: Entities nearby the user will begin to glow.
effect.tipsylib.pyromaniac.description: Heals the user slowly while standing in fire.
effect.tipsylib.tempus.description: Increases the tick rate of the user's active effects.
effect.tipsylib.trail_blazing.descriptio: When not sneaking, a trail of fire will emit from the user's feet.
effect.tipsylib.traversal.description: Teleports the user to their spawn location or world spawn if none is found.
effect.tipsylib.water_walking.descriptio: Allows the user to walk on water.
